closing.summary: Big strengths are omega 3, carb quality, and fermented dairy practicality is a real plus, but the biggest weaknesses are low magnesium, low vitamin A, and low protein quality. It is good for practical meals, bone health, and blood and oxygen support because the food-type role makes it easy to build meals around, calcium and vitamin D gives the bone-health case something to work with, and vitamin B12 supports the blood-and-oxygen side.
